instrument.warmup_rule: the first declared flatten action whose region is a proper subset of the field — decided from the declaration, before any measurement
instrument.target_source: the world's own solved score (mu.TargetScore = w_mu/Ceiling + w_gain + w_closed), so the episode does not terminate at a partial solution before a two-step order difference can be walked
instrument.prediction_source: closed forms from TD1 (mu state equation), TD11 (gain = flattening progress), TD15/TD16 (order difference), recomputed by this file's own operator algebra — never by calling Go or re-reading the world's numbers
instrument.a_definition: A(a,b) = score(theta->a->b) - score(theta->b->a); score is the world's raw info.score, exactly as for the params world (one ruler, two worlds)
instrument.actions_from: the world's own declared action space (the whole declared set, no sampling choice)

control_inside_mu.note: the mu world's own zero-reading check: pairs the theorem says commute (predicted A = 0, i.e. the lamellar flatten pairs of GCA6 and the already-flat pairs) must read inside the ruler's zero band, exactly as the params world's control group does

td16_order_difference.source: TD12 (Q_Omega = 0 => eta = 1 => mu = 1 in one step) + TD15/TD16 (the order difference is (1-mu)(1-eta_before)) with the world's declared weights
td16_order_difference.observed_inputs: mu and eta_before are the world's own info.mu / info.eta at the pre-state
